Fueling Deicing

Filtro de combustível

A device in the fuel system designed to remove contaminants from aviation fuel before it reaches the engine or fuel system components. Ensures only clean fuel is delivered to prevent engine malfunction or damage.

Quick answer: A device in the fuel system designed to remove contaminants from aviation fuel before it reaches the engine or fuel system components. Ensures only clean fuel is delivered to prevent engine malfunction or damage.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Filtro de combustível?

In this glossary, Filtro de combustível refers to: A device in the fuel system designed to remove contaminants from aviation fuel before it reaches the engine or fuel system components. Ensures only clean fuel is delivered to prevent engine malfunction or damage.

How is Filtro de combustível used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "A manutenção relatou que o filtro de combustível foi substituído antes da partida do motor devido ao risco de contaminação."

Why does Filtro de combustível matter in aviation?

Filtro de combustível matters because it supports clear communication in Fueling Deicing contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Filtro de combustível?

Filtro de combustível is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Filtro de combustível belong to?

In this glossary, Filtro de combustível is grouped under Fueling Deicing. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A device in the fuel system designed to remove contaminants from aviation fuel before it reaches the engine or fuel system components. Ensures only clean fuel is delivered to prevent engine malfunction or damage.
